note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts, provisions, levels and readings are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. The two link states are supplied by the author; nothing says which instrument is valid, lawful or binding, and no scene wins.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Scene A: the link state 'authorization supplied' — the clip is clamped on the enabling page. Scene B: 'authorization to be checked' — the clip is laid open beside the page and the passage only gets a pencil outline. Everything else is identical and printed once below.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: different fictional texts, both texts on the same user-supplied level, and the reversed assignment — scene A is 'to be checked', scene B 'supplied' — so the fastened clip appears in B.
